I am a young man in Mbeya, and maize is my life on this 1.27 hectare plot. The soil here in the Southern Highlands is good, but it still needs help — I will buy some urea and DAP if the prices at the agrodealer are not too bad, though I cannot afford the full recommended rate. I will use improved seed from the SeedCo or Meru agrodealer because the yields are much better than the grains I save myself, and I will spread the manure from my few goats and chickens before planting. I have no pump for irrigation, so I depend on the rains, and I will weed with my hoe together with my wife and younger brother, hiring a few neighbors only for planting and the first weeding when time is short.
